ms.report:
The platform launched last month with the first real world asset (Tokenized Granite).
See finest.investments

Note to reviewers: We have no way to deal with individual bugs like the one reported by the reviewer. We need more context. Whats your email, where are you stuck? Signup or KYC? What browser are you using? Please before refusing the Milestone for a reason like this, try to go through the support channel on the page (nmkr.io/support) and we'll gladly help you out.
We have almost 200 successful registrations and have sold out the first Drop, so I in most cases it seems to work.
Your feedback is very valuable because obviously we want to make sure everything is working for everyone. But refusing the Milestone is simply blocking important funding, hindering potential Salary Payouts - with too little details for us to actually do anything about it.
Thanks for your consideration
